verified.organizer: CIGRE (International Council on Large Electric Systems)
verified.evidence: Official CIGRE Technical Programme + national news agency (Agerpres 23 Aug 2026) + Paris Convention Bureau listing.

summaries.overview: The CIGRE Paris Session is the industry's principal global power-systems gathering. The 2026 edition (23-28 August, Paris) drew transmission, distribution and equipment players, with transformer and grid-component vendors prominent.

facts.statement: CIGRE Paris Session 2026 was held 23-28 August 2026 in Paris.
Hitachi Energy presented its grid portfolio at CIGRE 2026 ("CIGRE 2026 – Powering the Electricity Era").

facts.source_title: Toshiba — to Exhibit at CIGRE Paris 2026

facts.statement: Trench Group exhibited at CIGRE Paris 2026 and launched an integrated power-quality package (bushing / component vendor).
facts.source_title: Trench Group at CIGRE Paris 2026 (via public company release); Transformer Magazine

facts.statement: WIKA presented transformer / grid instrumentation (pressure, temperature, monitoring) at CIGRE.
LS Electric and LS Cable & System exhibited together at CIGRE 2026, targeting the European next-generation power-grid market.
facts.source_title: Asia Economic Daily (asiae.co.kr) — LS Electric & LS Cable & System to participate together in CIGRE 2026

facts.statement: CHINT showcased AI-ready grid equipment at CIGRE 2026 amid Europe's AI-driven capacity crunch.
facts.source_title: Data Centre Solutions — CHINT showcased AI-ready grid solutions at CIGRE 2026

facts.statement: Baobian Electric (Chinese power-transformer manufacturer) exhibited at the 2026 CIGRE international session.
facts.source_title: NetEase / Chinese media — Baobian Electric at the 2026 CIGRE international session

sections.event_overview: Biennial CIGRE Paris Session (23-28 Aug 2026); global power-systems gathering with a strong transformer / grid-equipment vendor presence.
sections.transformer_industry_presence: Hitachi Energy, Toshiba, Trench Group, WIKA, LS Electric, CHINT, Baobian Electric among vendors exhibiting transformer / grid / component products.
sections.key_announcements: Trench Group launched an integrated power-quality package; CHINT highlighted AI-ready grid solutions.
sections.product_technology_developments: Grid-reinforcement and data-centre/AI-driven capacity were stated themes; transformer-component and instrumentation vendors were active.
sections.project_procurement_signals: European grid reinforcement and next-generation power-grid market interest were cited by exhibitors (LS Electric; CHINT). No confirmable contract/award values without a listed source.
sections.market_themes: European grid modernization, AI/data-centre load growth and grid resilience were recurrent exhibitor themes.
sections.what_to_watch_next: Multiple major transformer and grid-equipment vendors (Hitachi Energy, Toshiba, Trench, LS Electric, CHINT) presented; the stated European grid-reinforcement and AI-driven capacity themes imply related procurement activity worth monitoring in the EU region.
sections.sources: CIGRE official technical programme; Hitachi Energy; Toshiba; Trench Group (via Transformer Magazine); WIKA; LS Electric (Asia Economic Daily); CHINT (Data Centre Solutions); Baobian Electric (available at source); national news agency (Agerpres).

verified.evidence: Organizer post-event article (CWIEME Berlin); China News Service (Shanghai); Transformer Magazine event listing.

summaries.overview: The CWIEME Shanghai trade fair covers coil winding, electrical machines and transformer manufacturing. The 2026 edition was held in Shanghai in late June; its reported headline themes were EV/robotics/eVTOL (coil/motor), so transformer-specific findings are limited to the transformer-manufacturing segment.

facts.statement: CWIEME Shanghai 2026 was held in Shanghai, China in late June 2026.
facts.source_title: CWIEME Berlin — CWIEME Shanghai 2026 sets the benchmark (organiser post-event)

facts.statement: Transformer Magazine covered CWIEME Shanghai 2026 as a transformer-manufacturing event.
ZTELEC Group (transformer / electrical-equipment manufacturer) exhibited at CWIEME Shanghai 2026 (booth 1N21).
facts.source_title: ZTELEC Group — Successful Opening Day at CWIEME Shanghai 2026

sections.event_overview: CWIEME Shanghai 2026 (late June 2026, Shanghai) covers coil winding, motors and transformer manufacturing; the 2026 narrative emphasised EV/robotics/eVTOL.
sections.transformer_industry_presence: Transformer-manufacturing segment present; ZTELEC Group exhibited. Transformer Magazine covered the event.
sections.key_announcements: No confirmable transformer-specific product/contract announcement was found in the reviewed public sources; the show reported record growth and robotics/EV highlights, which are outside transformer scope.
sections.product_technology_developments: Transformer-relevant product announcements not confirmed in reviewed sources.
sections.market_themes: Coil/motor and EV/robotics themes dominated the 2026 narrative; transformer-manufacturing was a secondary segment.
sections.what_to_watch_next: Transformer-manufacturing suppliers (ZTELEC and similar) were present; monitor the show's transformer-manufacturing segment, particularly Chinese coil-winding/insulation suppliers, for medium-voltage activity.
sections.sources: CWIEME Berlin (organiser); Transformer Magazine; ZTELEC Group; China News Service (Shanghai).

verified.organizer: Middle East Energy (Informa Exhibitions); Dubai World Trade Centre event
verified.evidence: Credible industry media coverage (Technical Review Middle East, Alain Charles Publishing, 3 Sep 2026). Secondary-source verification of occurrence/edition; not an official organizer post-event report.

summaries.overview: Middle East Energy 2026 was the 50th edition of the Gulf's flagship power & energy exhibition, held in Dubai and running until 3 September 2026. Coverage emphasised AI and digital innovation at the core of energy strategy, supply-chain decentralisation, and regional power-sector growth.

facts.statement: Middle East Energy 2026 was the 50th edition and ran until 3 September 2026 in Dubai.
facts.source_title: Technical Review Middle East — Middle East Energy 2026 drives the global energy dialogue

facts.statement: Shandong Taikai exhibited high-voltage power transmission and transformation equipment at Middle East Energy 2026.
facts.source_title: Technical Review Middle East — Middle East Energy 2026

facts.statement: Hunan Guochuang Electric showcased precision-engineered transformer components for the new-energy and ultra-high-voltage sectors.
facts.source_title: Technical Review Middle East — Middle East Energy 2026

facts.statement: Lucy Electric launched the Nuventura Nu1, an SF6-free switchgear rated up to 36 kV (grid/switchgear — not a transformer).
facts.source_title: Technical Review Middle East — Middle East Energy 2026

sections.event_overview: Middle East Energy 2026 (50th edition), Dubai, to 3 Sep 2026 — Gulf's flagship power & energy exhibition.
sections.transformer_industry_presence: Transformer-relevant exhibitors noted in reviewed media: Shandong Taikai (high-voltage power transmission & transformation equipment) and Hunan Guochuang Electric (precision transformer components, UHV segment).
sections.key_announcements: Lucy Electric launched the SF6-free Nuventura Nu1 switchgear (up to 36 kV) — a grid/switchgear development, not a transformer product. No transformer-specific product launch was confirmable from reviewed sources.
sections.product_technology_developments: Reviewed coverage centred on AI-driven grid/infrastructure innovation and SF6-free switchgear; transformer-specific launches were not confirmed.
sections.project_procurement_signals: No confirmable transformer contract/award value found in reviewed sources; regional power-sector growth was a stated theme without sourced figures.
sections.market_themes: AI at the core of energy strategy; supply-chain decentralisation; regional power-sector growth; Leadership Summit keynote by H.E. Omar Sultan Al Olama (UAE).
sections.what_to_watch_next: Monitor the transformer/component exhibitors (Shandong Taikai, Hunan Guochuang Electric) and MENA grid investment; the next edition (Middle East Energy 2027) is UPCOMING with dates not yet confirmed (TBC).
sections.sources: Technical Review Middle East (credible industry media).
